text: The purpose of this report is to provide the Board with an overview of the history, current status and future direction of Civic Theatres Toronto's health and safety program.

The Board of Directors of Civic Theatres Toronto: 1. Received the report (January 15, 2018) from the Vice President of Operations for information. 2. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1, 2, 3 and 4 to the report (January 15, 2018) from the Vice President of Operations remain confidential as they pertain to the security of property belonging to the City or one of its agencies, boards, and commission.
